package game

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	playerentity "example.com/planet/game/entities/player"
	worldentity "example.com/planet/game/entities/world"
	coredata "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	dataengine "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine/engine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nestwal"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/bus"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
	fnats "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/nats"
	natsdriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/nats/driver"
	fmongo "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/mongo"
	mongodriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/mongo/driver"
	fredis "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis"
	redisdriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis/driver"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/account"
)

// realGateFixture 使用正式账号 RPC、Redis 目录和 Mongo 投影。平台身份由本次运行的
// HMAC 签发器证明，不伪装为 Steam/Apple 等外部平台已经验收；密钥/票据不写日志。
type realGateFixture struct {
	store         *dataengine.MongoStore
	mongo         *mongodriver.Client
	mongoConfig   *fmongo.Config
	storeConfig   dataengine.MongoStoreConfig
	accounts      account.Accounts
	reopenAccount func() *account.Service
	playerID      int64
	ticket        string
	auth          gateway.Authenticator
}

func newRealGateFixture(t *testing.T) *realGateFixture {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("ROOST_GATE_REAL") != "1" {
		return nil
	}
	uri, addr, url := os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_MONGO_URI"), os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_REDIS_ADDR"), os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_NATS_URL")
	if uri == "" || addr == "" || url == "" {
		t.Fatal("real Gate requires isolated Mongo, Redis and NATS")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	prefix := fmt.Sprintf("roost:gate:real:%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
	redis, err := redisdriver.NewClient(fredis.DefaultConfig(addr))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = redis.Close() })
	stores, err := account.NewRedisStores(redis, prefix, time.Minute)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	secret := make([]byte, 32)
	if _, err = rand.Read(secret); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sign := func(id string) string {
		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, secret)
		_, _ = mac.Write([]byte(id))
		return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
	}
	accountConfig := account.Config{Accounts: stores.Accounts, Roles: stores.Roles, Servers: stores.Servers, Slots: stores.Slots, Names: stores.Names, SessionSecret: hex.EncodeToString(secret),
		Verifier: account.VerifierFunc(func(_ context.Context, id account.Identity) (account.Verified, error) {
			if id.Channel != "gate-it" || !hmac.Equal([]byte(id.Credential), []byte(sign(id.OpenID))) {
				return account.Verified{}, account.ErrIdentityDenied
			}
			return account.Verified{Channel: id.Channel, OpenID: id.OpenID}, nil
		}), Allocator: account.AllocatorFunc(func(ctx context.Context, _ int32) (int64, error) {
			id, err := redis.Incr(ctx, prefix+":player_id")
			return id + 100000, err
		}), NameRules: account.NameValidatorFunc(func(name string) error {
			if len(name) < 3 || len(name) > 32 {
				return account.ErrNameInvalid
			}
			return nil
		})}
	reopen := func() *account.Service {
		svc, err := account.New(accountConfig)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return svc
	}
	owner := reopen()
	if _, err = owner.UpsertServer(ctx, account.GameServer{ID: 22, Name: "gate-real", Status: account.ServerOpen}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	nc, err := natsdriver.NewClient(fnats.DefaultConfig(url), natsdriver.ClientOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rpc := natsdriver.NewRPCClient(nc, fnats.DefaultRetryPolicy(), 2)
	transport := bus.New(nc, rpc, bus.MessagePackCodec{}, bus.Config{Sid: 31, SvcType: "account", Prefix: strings.ReplaceAll(prefix, ":", "."), WorkerNum: 2, QueueCap: 32})
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_ = transport.StopWithContext(ctx)
		_ = rpc.StopWithContext(ctx)
		nc.Close()
	})
	if err = account.RegisterHandlers(transport, owner); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = transport.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = nc.FlushContext(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	accounts, err := account.NewBusClient(transport, "account", 5*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	identity := account.Identity{Channel: "gate-it", OpenID: "owner", Credential: sign("owner")}
	if _, err = accounts.Login(ctx, account.Identity{Channel: "gate-it", OpenID: "owner", Credential: "invalid"}); !errors.Is(err, account.ErrIdentityDenied) {
		t.Fatalf("invalid identity not refused: %v", err)
	}
	logged, err := accounts.Login(ctx, identity)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	role, err := accounts.CreateRole(ctx, logged.ID, 22, "GatePlayer")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	replay, err := accounts.CreateRole(ctx, logged.ID, 22, "GatePlayer")
	if err != nil || replay.PlayerID != role.PlayerID {
		t.Fatal("role creation retry changed identity", err)
	}
	other, err := accounts.Login(ctx, account.Identity{Channel: "gate-it", OpenID: "outsider", Credential: sign("outsider")})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = accounts.SelectRole(ctx, other.ID, role.PlayerID); !errors.Is(err, account.ErrNotPermitted) {
		t.Fatal("role owner check failed", err)
	}
	session, err := accounts.SelectRole(ctx, logged.ID, role.PlayerID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fixture := &realGateFixture{accounts: accounts, reopenAccount: reopen, playerID: role.PlayerID, ticket: fmt.Sprintf("session:%d:%s", role.PlayerID, session.Token)}
	fixture.auth = gateway.AuthenticatorFunc(func(ctx context.Context, ticket string, _ net.Addr) (gateway.Principal, error) {
		rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(ticket, "session:")
		if !ok {
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
		id, token, ok := strings.Cut(rest, ":")
		if !ok {
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
		playerID, err := strconv.ParseInt(id, 10, 64)
		if err != nil {
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
		role, err := accounts.ValidateSession(ctx, playerID, token)
		if err != nil {
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
		return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: role.PlayerID, ServerID: role.ServingServerID, SessionID: fmt.Sprintf("real-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())}, nil
	})
	database := fmt.Sprintf("roost_gate_real_%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
	configured := map[string]string{}
	for _, declared := range coredata.DeclaredDatabases() {
		configured[declared.Name] = database
	}
	databases, _, err := coredata.NewDatabaseMap(coredata.DatabaseMapConfig{Declared: coredata.DeclaredDatabases(), Configured: configured, ServerID: 22})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fixture.mongoConfig = fmongo.DefaultConfig(uri)
	fixture.mongo, err = mongodriver.NewClient(fixture.mongoConfig, mongodriver.IndexMigrationPolicy{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_ = fixture.mongo.Close(ctx)
	})
	fixture.storeConfig = dataengine.MongoStoreConfig{DefaultDatabase: database, Databases: databases, ServerID: 22}
	fixture.store, err = dataengine.NewMongoStore(fixture.mongo, fixture.storeConfig)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = fixture.store.EnsureInfrastructure(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Log("real account Login/CreateRole/SelectRole via NATS MessagePack and Redis passed; external identity provider not included")
	return fixture
}

func (f *realGateFixture) verifyRecovery(t *testing.T, walDir string, record coredata.CommitRecord, player *playerentity.Player, world *worldentity.World) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	// 重新创建账号服务，从 Redis 目录校验原会话，不能只依赖旧服务对象缓存。
	_, token, _ := strings.Cut(strings.TrimPrefix(f.ticket, "session:"), ":")
	if _, err := f.reopenAccount().ValidateSession(ctx, f.playerID, token); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := f.mongo.Close(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fresh, err := mongodriver.NewClient(f.mongoConfig, mongodriver.IndexMigrationPolicy{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer fresh.Close(context.Background())
	store, err := dataengine.NewMongoStore(fresh, f.storeConfig)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wal, err := nestwal.Open(nestwal.DefaultOptions(walDir))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	projector, err := dataengine.NewProjector(wal, store, dataengine.DefaultProjectorOptions())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer projector.Close(context.Background())
	if err = projector.Flush(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// 重投同一事务，不重复经验或等级；两个 DAO 在 Mongo 会话事务中落地。
	for range 2 {
		if err = store.Project(ctx, record); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	coldPlayer, coldWorld := newScenePlayer(t, f.playerID), newSceneWorld(t)
	for _, mutation := range record.Mutations {
		docs, err := store.Load(ctx, coredata.LoadSpec{Database: mutation.Key.Database, Scope: mutation.Key.Scope, Resource: mutation.Key.Resource, Filter: map[string]any{"_id": mutation.Key.ID}})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(docs) != 1 || docs[0].Version != mutation.NextVersion || docs[0].Schema != mutation.Schema {
			t.Fatalf("persisted identity/version mismatch for %s", mutation.Key.Resource)
		}
		doc := docs[0]
		switch doc.Key.ID {
		case player.ID():
			err = coldPlayer.Dao().RestorePersisted(doc.Data, doc.Schema, doc.Version)
		case world.ID():
			err = coldWorld.Dao().RestorePersisted(doc.Data, doc.Schema, doc.Version)
		default:
			t.Fatal("unexpected persisted entity")
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if coldPlayer.Dao().GetExp() != player.Dao().GetExp() || coldPlayer.Dao().GetLevel() != player.Dao().GetLevel() || coldWorld.Dao().GetExpGranted() != world.Dao().GetExpGranted() {
		t.Fatal("cold DAO differs from acknowledged business result")
	}
	t.Log("PASS real Gate: Redis account reload, Mongo two-DAO transaction, WAL reopen, transaction replay and cold generated DAO hydration")
}
